assessments.rationale: The wallet file is documented as holding "wallet data and keys" (evd-004), which in the context of a cryptocurrency wallet implies long-lived private keys used to sign blockchain transactions. The Electrum components connect to external ElectrumX servers for blockchain data (evd-003), so compromise of the wallet file would compromise keys that authenticate transactions on an external blockchain network. The documentation does not mention any managed secret store or equivalent mechanism for protecting these keys beyond the optional wallet encryption (evd-004). It is therefore well supported that a requirement on managed protection of signing keys (req-SECRET-001) is applicable to a threat about compromise of keys from the wallet file, and that its satisfaction is unverified given the absence of any described managed secret store.
